decisions.decision: Historical Commission asked to prioritize the Town Hall repainting and chimney repair if the items are separated.

decisions.decision: Pistols & Holsters remain on the Plan.

Police department computers, laptops, toughbooks, printers, cameras and fax machine remain on the Plan; Fire, Public Safety Building, Board of Selectmen, Board of Health, Treasurer, Building, Eagle House, Library, Town Clerk and Town Manager items likewise remain on the Plan.
